detail.longDescription: Tab hoarding is deferred decision-making — each open tab is an "I'll deal with this later" that you never close. The fix isn't discipline. It's a better system: named sessions for context tabs, read-later for articles, close everything else. https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/the-hi dden-cost-of-tab-hoarding-and-a-system-that-actually-helps-3fc9 # Productivity # ADHD # PKM # Firefox # BrowserTips
